given_when_then.given: An authorized user requests the history of a Delivery Assignment
given_when_then.then: The system returns the complete status history for the requested Delivery Assignment.

given_when_then.given: A user is not authorized to query a specific Delivery Assignment
given_when_then.when: The user attempts to query the history
given_when_then.then: The system denies access and returns an authorization error.

given_when_then.given: The system receives a request to query a Delivery Assignment by ID
given_when_then.then: The system returns the history with entries ordered chronologically.

success_criteria: The system returns the complete status history for the requested Delivery Assignment.
The system denies access to unauthorized users.
The system returns history entries ordered chronologically.
